'''Agrippa Aldrete''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] hailing from the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Aldrete served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of his [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], under the reign of [[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Mazicia Organa|Mazicia]] of Alderaan. He was later succeeded by his compatriot [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], to whom he eventually became a [[senatorial aide]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Agrippa Aldrete was still serving in the Senate, and he witnessed the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|political turmoil]] that resulted from the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the small planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] conglomerate.

==Biography==
Agrippa Aldrete was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="db" /> a very old, pristine [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Agrippa shared his surname<ref name="db" /> with other [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] of note, namely the [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] [[Alya Aldrete]]<ref name="CSWEAlya">{{CSWECite|I|19|Alya Aldrete}}</ref> and the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] [[Celana Aldrete]].<ref name="CSWECel">{{CSWECite|I|19|Celana Aldrete}}</ref> Agrippa Aldrete [[Age of responsibility|came of age]] at seventeen, following the Alderaanian law.<ref name="Age of responsibility">''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' establishes that the "[[age of responsibility]]" on both [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was set at seventeen.</ref> He built himself a career as a [[Politics/Legends|politician]], ascending to the position of [[Senator/Legends|senator]], with the duty to represent Alderaan's [[Alderaan sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="db" /> His [[Alderaanian delegation/Legends|delegation]] held considerable power in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]],<ref name="YJCCG">{{YJCCG|set=Battle of Naboo|cardname=Alderaan Diplomat|link=battleofnaboo/light/large/26alderaandiplomatsenator.html}}</ref> since Alderaan was once part of the [[Tetrahedron]], an ancient area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding worlds]] of the Republic.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:TantiveIVToydaria-SL.png|thumb|left|250px|The CR90 corvette ''Star of Alderaan'' was built for Senator Aldrete to use.]]
During Aldrete's mandate, the reigning [[King/Legends|Queen]] of Alderaan was [[Mazicia Organa]],<ref name="ins">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref> [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to the future [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and [[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].<ref name="SWB:RE">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref> The Queen ordered the construction of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Star of Alderaan'']], a blockade runner [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] which was reserved for Senator Aldrete's use.<ref name="ins" />

At some point before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' has [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the proposed [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], which is dated to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Senator Aldrete stepped down from office, making way for his fellow Alderaanian [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]]<ref name="db" />&mdash;who held the title of [[Prince/Legends|prince]] on their planet.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Former senator Aldrete eventually returned to the Senate as an [[Senatorial aide|aide]] to his successor,<ref name="db" /> a duty he shared with the female [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Liana Merian/Legends|Liana Merian]].<ref name="liana">{{DB|character|lianamerian|Merian, Liana}}</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], concurrent with Agrippa Aldrete still serving in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as established by {{DB|character|aldrete|Aldrete, Agrippa}}, to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Agrippa Aldrete was still a member of the Senate<ref name="db" /> when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a complex organization of trade officials and associated bureaucrats, [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the remote world of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Following the crisis, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was removed from office and [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|replaced]] by Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Agrippa Aldrete was a light-skinned man with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a slim build. At the time of the Naboo crisis, he was an older gentleman sporting short gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]], darker bushy eyebrows and a pointy goatee.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

==Equipment==
Following a tradition of the Alderaanian ambassadorial community,<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> he wore an all-white [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]] parting down the middle, with a high collar and ornated with sober stripes of embroidered lozenges.<ref name="TPMIG" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character origins===
[[File:AgrippaPortrait.png|thumb|150px|Agrippa Aldrete]]
Agrippa Aldrete was among the many characters that were ultimately cut from the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="TPM cut">{{Film|I}} {{C|Deleted scene featured on the [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray]] edition}}</ref> He was featured in a scene where Bail Organa, played by the [[Wikipedia:Ireland|Irish]] actor [[Adrian Dunbar]], seconded the motion for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the leadership of Chancellor Valorum. Aldrete was present in Bail Organa's [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] along with Liana Merian and another [[Unidentified draped senator|draped senator]]. The scene even contained a medium shot focused on Organa and Aldrete, with the senator searching the eyes of his aide, waiting for his approval before standing up to support the motion. The actor had no dialogue, however, and Aldrete only signaled his approval by a short bow.<ref name="TPM cut" />

Although that scene was ultimately excised from the final movie, Adrian Dunbar's likeness was later reused as Bail Antilles,<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref> and Agrippa Aldrete was referenced in various sources that brought him back into [[canon]]. A picture of him appeared in the reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was put on the market the same year as the movie.<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Years later, in [[October]] [[2006]], an article from the ''[[Refresher Reading]]'' feature of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine established a link between Aldrete, Mazicia Organa and the ''Star of Alderaan''. In the article, however, the character's name was misspelled as "Aggripe Aldrite."<ref name="ins" />

In real-life, "Agrippa" was originally an old [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]] name that was first used as a [[Wikipedia:Praenomen|praenomen]] (a given name) and afterwards as a [[Wikipedia:Cognomen|cognomen]] (an "additional" name, which distinguished branches of a clan from each other).<ref name="TAL">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ancientlibrary.com/smith-bio/0085.html|text=Smith's Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology|work=The Ancient Library|archivedate=20150401070137}}</ref> According to [[Wikipedia:University of Wisconsin–Green Bay|University of Wisconsin–Green Bay's]] [http://news.uwgb.edu/featured/leading-learning/01/22/aldrete-inspires-students official news page], Agrippa Aldrete was named after the university's Professor Gregory Aldrete and his Labrador retriever Agrippa.<ref name="UWGB">{{WebCite|url=http://news.uwgb.edu/featured/leading-learning/01/22/aldrete-inspires-students|text=Award winner: Aldrete's scholarship, enthusiasm inspire students|author=Anderson, R. Terry|date=2010-01-22|work=[http://news.uwgb.edu Inside UW-Green Bay News]|archivedate=20150922125307}}</ref>

===Lookalikes===
{{Quote|Algrippa ''[sic]'' doesn't have the side beard. Also, this model is replicated in some shots, so who's to say which one is the real Agrippa Aldrete?|Leland Chee, regarding the Aldrete-lookalike seen in ''The Clone Wars''|<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|author=Leland Chee|date=September 20, 2012|quote=Also, this model is replicated in some shots, so who's to say which one is the real Agrippa Aldrete?|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=10201503293210309&id=201820953172172&comment_id=6730243&offset=0&total_comments=1|dateaccessed=July 16, 2013|nobackup=true}}</ref>}}
[[File:Possible_Aldrete-TCW.png|thumb|left|Aldrete's double in ''Assassin'']]
The likeness of Aldrete has often been reused for separate characters in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|video game adaptation]] of ''Star Wars Episode I'', a [[Unidentified Coruscant Tourist Director|character]] working at the [[Tourist Center]] on Coruscant resembled Aldrete, both in clothing and physical traits. Later in the game, another individual represented by the same character model could be encountered in the lower levels of Coruscant.<ref name="TMPVG">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>

In [[2010]], a character matching Aldrete's physical appearance and characteristic outfit appeared alongside Senators Bail Organa, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]]," a [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="A">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref> [[2012|Two years]] later, the same character model was also used in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," although with a different outfit. In that episode, the Aldrete lookalike attended Chancellor Palpatine's speech on the occasion of Naboo's annual [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]].<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Nonetheless, Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]] [[Leland Chee]] later indicated that the character seen in ''The Clone Wars'' was not Agrippa, stating that the beard looked too different and that the character model was replicated in some shots.<ref name="FB" />
